description: Police track motor vehicle flight incidents, including pursuits and outcomes.

chips.text: Reasons for motor vehicle evasion trends were not broken down in the report.

speakers.name: Nolan Berg
speakers.summary: Nolan Berg presented the report and responded to questions of the Board, along with Chief McBride.
said: Presented the annual report on flight from peace officer incidents.
Provided statistics on incidents with no pursuit, with pursuit, and terminated pursuits.
Explained the review process and criteria for police pursuit decisions.

description: Saskatoon Police used force in 0.17% of 2025 calls.
Use of force incidents decreased 26% from 2024.
Public Safety Unit deployed 110 times with no force.

chips.text: Commissioner Jeffries noted 0.17% use of force counters misconceptions.
Public Safety Unit deployments were included in the report for the first time.
Staff will consider including Public Safety Unit deployments in future reports.

speakers.name: Cory Goodwin
speakers.summary: Cory Goodwin presented the report and responded to questions of the Board.
said: The 2025 Use of Force Report details the service's management and oversight of force.
Force was used in 0.17% of calls in 2025, a decrease from the previous year.
Use of force incidents decreased by 26% year-over-year despite increased call volume.

description: City police find tracking PACT team availability challenging.
PACT teams primarily respond to mental health crises.
Unavailability of PACT teams increases police response to incidents.

chips.text: Commissioner Grier noted PACT teams are not fully funded by the province.
Individuals experiencing mental health crises rely on PACT team availability.
Chief McBride offered to analyze dispatch data comparing PACT responses to mental health calls.
